title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.26
subtitle: GAIA owner evaluation — experimental, not production-ready.

highlights.title: Native GAIA owner test
highlights.description: Evaluate CUDA hydrodynamics with a separate local runtime and the approved frozen NEON dataset. The regular 30-frame Bake and playback after Blender restart have been validated.

highlights.title: Verified fluid inputs
highlights.description: Scene, material, attachment and fluid identities are checked before solving. Unsupported changes and corrupted sources fail safely; the native SDF and velocity guards stay active.

highlights.title: Account controls in the Companion
highlights.description: The account window follows the Welcome style. Blender shows read-only status. Backend-dependent account and activation features remain disabled until approved; login is not required for this test.

highlights.title: Clear experimental limits
highlights.description: NEON-only hydrodynamics, repeatability above the 8 mm screen and CPU/CUDA self-contact differences remain open. Solver binaries and scene assets are installed separately.
